{{Top|leg}}
The '''Yrashu language''' was spoken by the [[Yrashu]] of [[Baskarn]]. It consisted mainly of bilabial nasals and [[Wikipedia:schwa|schwa]] sounds, which sounded much like mumbling to the untrained ear.
